newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M rises nearly four pct to new high.
newsitem.headline: H&M rises nearly four pct to new high.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz AB (H&M) rose nearly four percent in early trade on Wednesday to a new high on a combination of factors.
At 0945 GMT H&M shares were 35 crowns higher at 980 crowns after hitting a high of 987 crowns earlier.

A broker said the rise was due to lower interest rates, stronger retail sales in September, and an announcement on Wednesday that the retailer will open its first store in France in the first half of 1998.
H&M said in a statement that it has signed a lease for a shop in the Rue de Rivoli in Paris and is in negotiations for several other sites.
